evidence.descriptor-interpretation: Names and order read from the exact matching native registration functions; armor/MR anchors bind group4 positions, group8 name order and numeric snapshots cross-check the extended mapping. Later group8 mixed-type fields stay raw.
evidence.composition-discovery: Derived from named stat components and 170 independent Riot stat snapshots in discovery. No damage amount used.
evidence.composition-check: Frozen composition checked at 360 snapshots of the separate game: AD358/360, AP360/360 within one point. API and replay updates have differing sampling times; discrepancies retained.
evidence.limits: Composition of replicated observations is not build/stat-model validation. Nonzero lethality and crit outcome semantics remain unverified; baseline zero penetration checks do not establish all penetration mechanics.
